premises.question: Does the candidate-order mechanism that causally restored selected PG-G symmetry cliffs recur across independently selected whole parent families?
evidence: Selected-pair strict-work factorial restored 6/6 solve-state cliffs by changing candidate order only; five DFS/admissible rows reproduced parent status/work exactly.
Repair seed normalization alone restored 0/1 selected repair cliff, so the independent confirmation centers candidate ordering rather than a seed campaign.
Complete pinned family-tree census exposes 54 direct seven-sibling `symmetry` families; after excluding all six discovery parents, 48 remain eligible without consulting solver outcomes.
alternatives: The selected cliffs are idiosyncratic to the discovery parents and do not recur independently.
Independent parents contain orientation discordance, but parent-frame ordering restores too little of it to support a recurring mechanism.
The mechanism transfers, earning design of a cold-legal current-input D4 tie-order consumer.
premises.discriminator: Freeze 12 parents by outcome-blind SHA-256 rank, use Stage A only to measure current-policy symmetry discordance, and run ordering treatment only on the predeclared discordant rows. Apply the frozen 70%/40% restoration thresholds and independent-parent minima.

premises.question: Should confirmation execute all treatment rows up front or first measure whether the opportunity population exists?
evidence: Repository research rules require control-side opportunity sizing before broad decision-bearing compute.
The discovery cohort was selected on response cliffs and cannot estimate independent-parent opportunity prevalence.
Stage A needs only 288 control rows and determines exactly which sibling×technique rows can inform the causal restoration question.
alternatives: Run parent-frame treatment on every sibling regardless of whether control differs from its parent.
Run a control-only opportunity map first and condition Stage B only on frozen discordance.
premises.discriminator: Stage A is the opportunity audit. If fewer than four independent parents or six rows are discordant, stop inconclusive without treatment expansion.

evidence: scripts/family-technique-response-campaign-plan.mjs already resolves historical family manifests against current parent corpora and verifies parent-content fingerprints.

scripts/technique-census-cell.mjs already owns isolated technique parsing, referee validation, strict equal-work caps including `_strictWorkCap`, deadline-truncation semantics and worker-safe execution.
The only missing execution input is an explicit research-only candidate-order description that can populate the already-merged `_candidateOrderResearchKey` hook.
alternatives: Copy the PG-G causal factorial runner and its budget logic into a second bespoke campaign.
Extend technique-census cells with an optional provenance-bearing research-order field and keep default behavior untouched.
premises.discriminator: Extend the shared cell executor only for the research-order input; Stage A and Stage B both otherwise reuse existing campaign/census/combine machinery.
